A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ReForm/PBSO research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-D support reliable comparison, including matching the relocated CriticLean analysis.

before.justification: V1 reports original autoformalization experiments, ablations, training analyses, ConsistencyCheck evaluations, and human evaluation of generated statements.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical studies and reports revised ReForm-32B results across four benchmarks.

M1.justification: The reflective generation/validation loop, heterogeneous rewards, clipped prospective returns, advantage normalization, and GRPO update remain unchanged. Appendix D retains the same substantive prompts; the revised scores do not establish a method change.

E1.justification: Both versions use miniF2F, ProofNet, PutnamBench, AIME2025, and the 859-item ConsistencyCheck benchmark. Training-data sources and represented tasks remain unchanged.

E2.justification: The participating comparison models in the main results, ablations, judge evaluation, and CriticLean comparison are unchanged. V1 Table 7 becomes v3 Table 4 with the same comparator membership.

E3.justification: Appendix B in v3 describes three-annotator review per statement but also retains v1's description of third-expert adjudication in disagreement cases. It is unclear whether senior review expanded or this merely documents the existing process. Benchmark sizes, metrics, model sizes, and training/inference settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The clipping, auxiliary-reward, RL, and one-pass ablations, training dynamics, iteration-distribution analysis, and case study are retained. The existing CriticLean robustness analysis moves from Appendix A.2 to Section 4.6; no new analytical question or test is introduced.

E5.justification: Figure 3's Avg@3 reporting and confidence-band discussion, and Section 4.5's standard-deviation claims, are retained. V3 adds no seed information, repeated-run counts, uncertainty-estimation procedure, or significance test.

E6.justification: Under the same stated automated-evaluation settings, Table 1 substantially revises ReForm-32B results: semantic scores on miniF2F/ProofNet/Putnam/AIME change from 89.8/65.6/57.0/56.7 to 91.4/70.4/62.3/66.7, raising the reported mean from 67.3 to 72.7. MiniF2F syntactic correctness falls from 98.4 to 97.1. Its CriticLean mean changes from 69.0 to 73.2, overtaking the unchanged ReForm-8B mean of 70.3. Baseline and ReForm-8B results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation in Section 3, including reward definitions and Equations 1-4, is unchanged. Neither version adds distinct theoretical propositions, proofs, or derivations relative to the other.

C1.justification: The headline average improvement increases from 17.2 to 22.6 percentage points in the abstract and corresponding introductory and concluding claims. The contributions of reflective autoformalization, PBSO, and ConsistencyCheck retain their original scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations of semantic gains, judge reliability, self-correction, and RL-induced refinement are retained, including the relocated CriticLean discussion. The added ethics statement supplies general societal-impact caveats without introducing a substantive scientific limitation or revised mechanism explanation.

D1.justification: Appendix B newly identifies six senior PhD annotators and describes their relevant experience, training, and review responsibilities for both ConsistencyCheck and output evaluation. The ethics statement adds compensation and withdrawal-right disclosures. Training/inference hyperparameters, substantive prompts, and first-page model/data/code links remain unchanged.

R1.justification: V3 adds citations to AlphaMath, step-level value preference optimization, IterResearch, WebResearcher, and two surveys; it removes ProRL, VAPO, and From Data-Centric to Sample-Centric. The substantive positioning against one-pass autoformalization and terminal-only rewards remains unchanged.

P1.justification: V3 adds acknowledgments and an ethics statement, expands Appendix B, and moves the robustness subsection into the main text. Affiliation text and citation style change, but most scientific prose and the overall narrative are retained.

P2.justification: V3 adopts ICLR headings and running headers, reflows tables and appendix boxes, and relocates the CriticLean table. Figure 2's loop drawing is adjusted, and Figure 4's misleading sample-count axis label is corrected to percentage. The underlying figure and table set is retained.

improvement.justification: V3 improves transparency through annotator qualifications, training, and labor disclosures, and corrects Figure 4's misleading axis label. The existing CriticLean analysis is easier to find in Section 4.6. These gains are limited: the higher ReForm-32B scores are unexplained, and the annotation descriptions remain ambiguous about when senior review applies.
